superseded_record_text.notes: Katsura et al. fit 11-20 GPa and 300-2100 K data with a BM3 reference isotherm plus Mie-Gruneisen-Debye thermal pressure. Their measured V0=538.49(2) A^3 and K0=169.2(9) GPa are fixed during the fit; K0'=4.1(1), gamma0=1.64(2), and q=1.5(1) are fitted, while theta0=814 K is fixed. Fixed source parameters retain their published uncertainties.
